declared_process_holds.requirement: Shapely geometric checks verify min width (8.0 um >= 5.0 um) and min spacing (12.0 um >= 5.0 um), but official KLayout/Calibre foundry PDK DRC deck signoff is required prior to photomask ordering.
20 nm Ti / 180 nm Pt e-beam evaporation and 400 C N2 anneal must verify alpha_Pt = 3.85e-3 K^-1 (+/-2%) and bridge pair ΔR/R0 <= 0.25% across a 100 mm fused-silica wafer.
250 C ALD bilayer must achieve <0.05 pinholes/cm^2 and >500 MOhm DC shunt resistance in 50 mM NaCl over 60 days at 45 C.
declared_process_holds.subsystem: 30 nm Al2O3 / 30 nm HfO2 Thermal/Plasma ALD Bilayer Pinhole Density

declared_process_holds.requirement: BCl3/Cl2 + SF6 RIE pad opening must stop on the 180 nm Pt bond pads with <15 nm Pt loss so wirebond/pogo contact resistance stays <0.15 Ohm.
declared_process_holds.subsystem: RIE Pad Opening Over-Etch Control on Pt Bond Pads

declared_process_holds.requirement: 5-axis CNC PEEK cell (Ra <= 0.8 um) with Parker 2-012 FKM O-ring must pass a 12.0 bar (1.5x 8.0 bar rating) 24-hour hydrostatic pressure hold with zero weepage.
declared_process_holds.subsystem: Virgin PEEK CNC Flow Cell & FKM O-Ring 12 Bar Hydrostatic Seal

declared_process_holds.requirement: Run native kicad-cli sch erc and PCB layout DRC on an engineering workstation with KiCad 7/8 installed before ordering 4-layer FR4 PCB prototypes.
declared_process_holds.subsystem: Native KiCad 7/8 CLI ERC & PCB Gerber Fabrication Signoff
